title: Srinagar Police hold piping ceremony for newly confirmed DySPs

ai.summary: Srinagar Police held a ceremony to formally confirm four officers to the rank of Deputy Superintendent of Police in Jammu and Kashmir Police after completing their probationary period.

facts.claim: Srinagar Police organised a ceremonial Piping Ceremony at Zonal Police Headquarters, Kashmir Zone, Srinagar, to felicitate four officers on their confirmation to the rank of Deputy Superintendent of Police (DySP) in Jammu and Kashmir Police.
facts.quote: Srinagar Police organised a ceremonial Piping Ceremony at Zonal Police Headquarters, Kashmir Zone, Srinagar, to felicitate four officers on their confirmation to the rank of Deputy Superintendent of Police (DySP) in Jammu and Kashmir Police.

facts.claim: The newly confirmed officers, Naveed Asad, Anwar Khanji, Repan and Farhana Beigh, were formally adorned with their rank insignias by Sujit Kumar, Inspector General of Police, Kashmir Zone, in the presence of Rajiv Omprakash Pandey, DIG Central Kashmir Range; Dr. G.V. Sundeep Chakravarthy, SSP Srinagar, and other senior police officers.
facts.quote: The newly confirmed officers, Naveed Asad, Anwar Khanji, Repan and Farhana Beigh, were formally adorned with their rank insignias by Sujit Kumar, Inspector General of Police, Kashmir Zone, in the presence of Rajiv Omprakash Pandey, DIG Central Kashmir Range; Dr. G.V. Sundeep Chakravarthy, SSP Srinagar, and other senior police officers.

facts.claim: The ceremony marked an important milestone in the officers' professional careers, recognising the successful completion of their probationary period and their formal confirmation in the rank of DySP.
facts.quote: The ceremony marked an important milestone in the officers' professional careers, recognising the successful completion of their probationary period and their formal confirmation in the rank of DySP.

facts.claim: Congratulating the officers, IGP Kashmir commended their dedication, professionalism and commitment to duty. He emphasised that the confirmation brings enhanced responsibilities and urged the officers to uphold the highest standards of integrity, discipline, accountability and public service.
facts.quote: Congratulating the officers, IGP Kashmir commended their dedication, professionalism and commitment to duty. He emphasised that the confirmation brings enhanced responsibilities and urged the officers to uphold the highest standards of integrity, discipline, accountability and public service.

facts.claim: DIG Central Kashmir Range also extended his congratulations and exhorted the officers to continue demonstrating exemplary leadership, professional competence and a people-friendly approach to Policing.
facts.quote: DIG Central Kashmir Range also extended his congratulations and exhorted the officers to continue demonstrating exemplary leadership, professional competence and a people-friendly approach to Policing.

facts.claim: The newly confirmed officers expressed their gratitude to the senior leadership of J&K Police for its constant guidance, encouragement and mentorship throughout their probationary period.
facts.quote: The newly confirmed officers expressed their gratitude to the senior leadership of J&K Police for its constant guidance, encouragement and mentorship throughout their probationary period.
